title: The Admin role has Settings Finance on and it cannot be turned off
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You check that the Admin role always keeps access to Finance settings.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Settings, Roles & Permissions.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the "Admin" role.
  2. Try to turn the "Finance" toggle off.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Admin role opens for editing. "Finance" is a sub-row under "Settings" and is on.
  • Step 2: the toggle cannot be turned off (it is disabled, as every Admin toggle is).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “By default 'Settings → Finance' is on for the Admin profile (required, cannot be turned off), Parts Manager and Office User, and off for Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Technician, Sales Representative and Time Clock User.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “On the Roles & Permissions screen these appear as "Finance" (a sub-row under "Settings" in the page-access toggles), the "Customers" row's "Create & Edit" column, and the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" cross toggle.”
